book.name: Maka
book.title: Ka꞉dle molo atlale yu Makata ilimale Maka

content: Yesuta do seme powale oplami ka꞉dle
Yu so inoma sumalalo alila haleta Yesu yia꞉ta inoma sumalalo aya dla hetaiyo. Aya dulu edla do seme powale oplami hale me-polaiyo.

Epapeleye Pa꞉lisi sotapo Yesuta yia꞉ aiyalma hale postamama do seme powale oplami ka꞉dlowe depo omsiyamaiyo. Adipalati, yia꞉ aiyalma koko dolumama yia꞉ta inoma sumalalo alila dla esiyele oplami hale ka꞉dloweye aiyalmayo.
Yesuta do seme powale oplami watle epo atlaiyo, “Wa꞉ta pola metle sila꞉timpuame haliyamale hema halane,” diyo.

Epame Yesu Pa꞉lisi so watle epo atlaiyo, “Dita inoma sumalalo alila dla apa koko haloweta aiyalmata꞉? Ka꞉dle koko haloweta꞉, o batalimale koko haloweta꞉? Epame pasakalo gadloweta꞉, o pasakalo yumuluweta꞉?” Epalati Pa꞉lisi sota ya꞉ yu dalepame allimama yu opi po-atlamaiyo.

Yesuta Pa꞉lisi so tlapame yia꞉ watle sikemte siyaladiyo. Amasiyama ya꞉ ma yia꞉ yilo sikemte dupa koliyo. Adipalati, yia꞉ta oplami i gadlowe dla dupa kokalalimale tlapame. Epame do seme powale oplami watle epo atlaiyo, “Wa꞉ do dolene,” diyo. Epalati oplamita ya꞉ do dolle oloma edla ya꞉ dota ma-ka꞉diyo.
Epalati Pa꞉lisi sota koko i natipame allimama yia꞉ta inoma sumalalo aya tle alikili dla tamalaiyo. Yia꞉ tame Helod ya꞉ alumale so mate Yesuye adipo hampo yumpa꞉ dle kokoye esemaiyo.
Opa hapulomata Yesu dolumtale

Yesu ya꞉ alotle tlalo so mate Ga꞉lili kaula dla tlati opa hapulomata ya꞉ dolumtaiyo. Opa hapuloma iwoloye mo meyelope meyelope dle itle pumulaiyo, opita Ga꞉lili tle epo Yudiya tle epo Yelusalem tle epo Idumiya tle epo Yoden aloma seme dla ha꞉ha꞉lalo mo tle epo Taya mate epo Saidon mate epame mo e mateka꞉pi dla ha꞉ha꞉lalo mo tle. Epedeme opa hapulomata Yesuta koko hamsela꞉le dlalepame mo meyelope meyelope dle itle Yesu hala dla pumulaiyo.

Opa hapuloma iwolota Yesu hala dla alumalati Yesuta esusulumale so opiye ka꞉ka꞉diyo. Epalati natipame esusulumale so opi hapulomata Yesu tluka ipi umuluwedeme opa alumale dulu dla sikemte akumtumulaiyo. Epedeme opata epo sikemte akumtumullati Yesuta ya꞉ alotle tlalo so watle epo atlaiyo, “Na꞉ koa hale momolo himme popa꞉iya,” diyo.
Epapele dulu dla bataliya watalo sota Yesu natipame ya꞉ hete sitali dla teteyupo ikiyelemhutiyemama epo atlamyaiyo, “Wa꞉ye God Yamipo,” demyaiyo.
Epalati Yesuta bataliya yimlala watle yu itiyamale mate epo atlamaiyo, “Wua꞉ opa watle atlemama na꞉ye God Yamipo demiyo,” diyo.
Yesuta Taiya dle so 12 hohomale
Yesu tamali di dla hetame halemama ya꞉ta solotamale so opa tlo sisilamaiyo.

Epame yia꞉ dulu dla ma opa 12 tlo hohomaiyo, ya꞉ mate siyamelepo depame. Epame yia꞉ watle Taiya dle so hi halopimama yia꞉ watle epo atlaiyo, “Na꞉ta wua꞉ye taiya dlowepo, God yu atlamsiyamelepo depame.
Epo wua꞉ watle itiyamale hamilowepo, wua꞉tapo bataliya yimlala opa dulu dla ha꞉ha꞉ye alikili dla dodolomsalemsiyamelepo depame,” diyo.
Epapele dulu dla Yesuta opa 12 iwolo hohomaiyo, Saimon (Yesuta ya꞉ hi hale sepo iyo, Pita)
epo Sebedi ya꞉ akimlala dapiyamte Yeims mate epo ya꞉ ei Yon mate. (Yesutapo yia꞉ hi hale sepo ilimaiyo, Bouwaneges. Adipalati, hi i dulu kokoye omapla some halalo so.)
Epo Endulu epo Pilipi epo Batolome epo Ma꞉tiyu epo Tomas epo Alpiyes yami Yeims epo Tadiyes epo Loum gamani so mate opahale demhalale oplami Saimon
epo Yudas Iskaliyot (alotle Yesu opahale do tama dla homelle.)
Yesu mate Belsebul mate
Yesu ma ilame aya dla tlati opata matle sikemte alumaiyo. Opata edla alumtumama Yesu mate ya꞉ alotle tlalo so mate daya dlowe alila ponatiyo.
Epalati Yesu ya꞉ asiyadulota Yesuta daya podlalo koko hamsela꞉le dalepame Yesu hamala puaiyo. Adipalati, yia꞉ta malamaleta Yesuye semte yiyilamselemapo depame.

Epalati aiyalma imalalo so Yelusalem tle pumulaleta epo atlaiyo, “Yesuye bataliya walena. Ya꞉ dulu dla bataliya yimlala yia꞉ dokopala oplami Belsebulta halapo. Epedeme ya꞉tapo Yesu dla itiyamale hamilati bataliya yimlala opa dulu dla ha꞉ha꞉ye alikili dla dodolomsalemhalapo,” diyo.
Epalati Yesuta aiyalma imalalo so sisilapame yia꞉ watle wayu mate epo imaiyo, “Saiten adipo ya꞉skamu opa dulu tle alikili dla dodolomsalepa꞉?
Epedeme mo hatlope sotapo yiskamu yia꞉ dulu dla duka gladepame opahale dlepiye, mo eye pohallowa, batalimelepe.
Epame asiya hatlope sota yiskamu yia꞉ dulu dla duka gladepame opahale dlepiye, asiya ewoloye poha꞉ha꞉lowa, batalimelepe.
Epo Saitentapo ya꞉skamu ya꞉ opa mate duka gladepame opahale dlepiye, ya꞉ mo kokota kokó pe-ellowa, medla pa꞉lepe.

Epedeme oplami haleta itiyamale oplami aya dla hetame alisisi uhalomolowedeme apelepiye, ya꞉ ka꞉yapa itiyamale oplami tatle dea mate yupo himilipe. Epame alotle ya꞉ aya dulu dla hetame alisisi uhalomelepe.
Epedeme na꞉ wua꞉ watle ikadepe koko atlema, batalimale koko hapuloma opata halomde mate epo yu batalimale God hi mate putlopo atlamde mateye Godta howahapo hiyostlepe.
Amasiyama oplami antapo Hela꞉dle Soko watle putlopo atlepiye, ya꞉ kokó elepo ellalo batalimale hapo. Epedeme ya꞉ batalimaleye pohowahapo hiyostlowa.”
Epapele dulu dla aiyalma imalalo sota Yesuye bataliya walena dlati Yesuta koko iye yia꞉ watle epo atlamaiyo.
Yesu ya꞉ wai mate epo ya꞉ eidulo mate
Epame Yesu ya꞉ wai mate ya꞉ eidulo mateta ya꞉ natila pumulaiyo. Epeleye yia꞉ puame alikili dla ha꞉ha꞉mama Yesu mate yukamolowe solotamama oplami hale watle Yesu atla tuane diyo.
Epalati opa hapuloma Yesu mate popa꞉leta ya꞉ watle epo atlaiyo, “Wa꞉ wai mate epo wa꞉ eidulo mate alikili dla wa꞉ omha꞉ha꞉uwo,” diyo.
Epalati Yesuta asiyama yia꞉ watle epo atlaiyo, “Na꞉ wai anata꞉? Epo na꞉ eidulo ma anawolota꞉?” diyo.
Amasiyama Yesuta opa hapuloma ya꞉ mate popa꞉le so dla tlapame yia꞉ watle epo atlaiyo, “Wua꞉ye na꞉ wai mate epo na꞉ eidulo matepo.
Adipalati, opa anawolotapo Godta solotamale koko halomha꞉ha꞉lepiye, ewoloye na꞉ eidulopo epo notimadulopo epo na꞉ waidulo ikadepepo.”
